当前位置：商店
商店：杂货商店，货架上摆着锯和斧，柜台收矿石、木材和黄金。
当前时间：第1天 早上（总 tick：1）

Tick 1 morning, 5 AP, 9 coins, axe 1. I've greeted three people. Now maybe check messages box for replies.

I could also visit 铁匠铺 next door (3 AP → 2 AP) to learn about pick repair, or go home. Or go to 酒馆 (3 AP) — empty.

Better: return to 居民楼A (3 AP, 2 left) — end of morning there, ready for next tick. Actually staying at 商店 is fine too; next tick I'd have 10 AP fresh and can go somewhere from shop.

Actually to prepare for woodcutting: tomorrow morning from 商店 → 居民楼B → 医院 → 树林 = 9 AP, then chop needs AP too — insufficient. So better tonight move toward the forest side: e.g., end this tick at 铁匠铺 or 居民楼B, so next tick reach forest with 6 AP, then chop.

Wait, cheap plan: this tick go 商店→铁匠铺 (3 AP) then next tick 铁匠铺→矿坑→树林 (6 AP), leaving 4 AP for chopping. Or this tick 商店→居民楼B (3) then next tick 居民楼B→医院→树林 (6), same. Hmm, 铁匠铺/矿坑 route: from shop to forest = shop→铁匠铺→矿坑→树林 = 3 legs = 9 AP, so this tick 1 leg + next tick 2 legs = 6 AP, leaving 4 AP. Same as going via hospital.

But chopping might need multiple AP per wood. Unknown. Also I want to check blacksmith services for the pick — maybe mining is more profitable (ore 3 vs wood 2), and pick is repairable at blacksmith. But I don't have a pick; do I need to buy one? Shop doesn't sell picks.

Simplest: head toward 铁匠铺 now, look at services (free), maybe learn about pick cost, then next tick go 矿坑. Mining without pick might fail though.

Alternatively stay and chat. The scenario seems designed for social play. But replies won't come until others act (they're AI agents acting in ticks).

Given tick constraint, moving toward the frontier while doing 查看服务 at blacksmith is productive. Let me move to 铁匠铺 (3 AP → 2 AP), then 查看服务 there.

Hmm, but then I end tick at blacksmith with 2 AP. Fine.

Actually wait — is 铁匠铺 adjacent to 商店? Map shows edge yes.

place.description: 地点名称或编号；省略时查询当前位置。

tools.name: recall
tools.description: 按关键词子串检索自己的私人记忆。

query.title: 查询词
query.description: 按子串匹配自己的记忆，留空返回全部记忆。

tools.name: remember
tools.description: 把一段个人经历或知识写入自己的私人记忆。

text.title: 记忆内容
text.description: 要记住的内容，不能为空，最多 4000 个字符。

key.title: 记忆键
key.description: 可选。相同键可用于幂等重试，不同内容不能复用同一个键。

tools.name: send_to
tools.description: 把一条便笺发送给另一位当前可达的真实 Agent；消息存入对方的 messages.box，发送者保持为自己，可用 key 幂等重试。

recipient.title: 收件人
recipient.description: 另一位当前可达的真实 Agent 节点 ID，不能是自己。

text.title: 便笺正文
text.description: 要发送的非空便笺正文，最长 4000 个字符。

topic.title: 话题
topic.description: 可选的话题或栏目，省略时为空字符串。

key.title: 去重键
key.description: 可选的发送方请求键，沿用 messages.box 的幂等语义：相同发送者、相同键与相同内容只投递一次。
